vibe-game.quote: the entire backend of the MMORPG BitCraft Online — chat, items, terrain, player positions — runs as one SpacetimeDB module
vibe-game.reason: Game backend with real-time state sync and Unity/Unreal SDKs, useful if the survival game needs persistence or multiplayer.

agent-viz.quote: Built-in liveness checks on dispatched runs, stall triage (diagnose child process tree, kill narrowest thing)
agent-viz.reason: Detects and handles background agents that hang, which is the hang-detection part of the brief.

hybrid-memory.quote: semantic vector search over full descriptions
hybrid-memory.reason: Adds embedding search over markdown records, measures recall@3 and shows where semantic beats keyword matching.

organize.quote: useful as source material for learning-vault ingestion and structured self-study
organize.reason: A course source that already feeds the user's learning-vault note system.

hybrid-memory.quote: a plain curated markdown wiki outscored all commercial memory products tested
hybrid-memory.reason: Benchmark evidence for comparing a markdown-record memory approach with RAG-style memory products.

wiki-scale.quote: A separate 5,000-page scale test was run alongside the primary benchmark.
wiki-scale.reason: A recall and hallucination benchmark plus a scale test of wiki-style memory, a method to copy.

hybrid-memory.quote: demonstrates that one well-formed sparse lexical action outperforms substantially more expensive multi-round search
hybrid-memory.reason: Research showing an enriched BM25 lexical search can beat dense retrieval, relevant before adding embeddings.

ocr-bench.quote: a fast deterministic local mode (Java-based, ~60 pages/sec on CPU) and a hybrid mode that routes complex pages to a local AI backend
ocr-bench.reason: A CPU PDF-to-markdown parser with its own benchmark numbers against docling and marker, a candidate to add.

local-llm.quote: Supports three backend flavors: oMLX (local Apple Silicon inference), Ollama, and any OpenAI-compatible server
local-llm.reason: Hands agentic coding work from Claude Code to locally run models.

local-llm.quote: Includes a sample model config block for Qwen 3.6 35B (4-bit quantized) with reasoning enabled: 64K context
local-llm.reason: Shows how to point Claude Code at a local Qwen model, with context-window settings and a KV-cache fix.

hybrid-memory.quote: pull-layer knowledge bundle (OKF v0.2 Markdown+YAML) searched via a pure-Go embedded MCP server with sub-300us in-memory BM25
hybrid-memory.reason: A close match: typed markdown memory records for coding agents, searched lexically.

wiki-scale.quote: corpus validation documented at ~4ms for 50+ concepts
wiki-scale.reason: Reports indexing, search and validation timings for a markdown knowledge bundle, and notes that recall metrics are missing.

ocr-bench.quote: Python wrapper around Amazon Textract for document intelligence
ocr-bench.reason: A hosted API option for table extraction from PDFs, for the benchmark's hosted-API arm.

ocr-bench.quote: three grading approaches — code-based, human, and model-based grading
ocr-bench.reason: Ways to score parser output against a golden baseline.

wiki-scale.quote: structure questions to enable automated grading
wiki-scale.reason: Guidance for building eval sets to check whether search still finds the right records.

hybrid-memory.quote: a useful checklist when evaluating any context graph or agent memory system's claims
hybrid-memory.reason: Lists the human and technical challenges a linked-graph memory system has to handle.
